hooks.text: 合并同类宝石角色放大增益并为每人配置Orb
hooks.excerpt: More in-depth party building than before! Do you know the proverb: "Three heads are better than one"? Gather several of the same jewels, enhance them, and see your buffs and synergy explode with power! And now, introducing "Orbs." You can equip Orbs to each character in your party, which means your ability to create and change your party has now expanded infinitely!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 自动战斗中实时组合或单独释放Gems支援队伍
hooks.excerpt: Strategic battles. In this game, the battles advance automatically while the player utilizes "Gems" to support their party during battle phases. With our new and improved battle system, the player can combine several Gems together or unleash the power of individual Gems!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 买卖宝石角色与同类合并形成贪心资源抉择
hooks.excerpt: Resource management that will test your thinking. The characters who battle for you are, after all, only jewels. That means you can "buy and sell" them. You can buy different types of Jewels or strengthen a single Jewel by merging several of the same Jewel with it. The choice is yours. Feel free to play around with your resources however you see fit. But be careful. If you're too greedy, you might find yourself being sucked into a dungeon here in the Underworld that you can't get out of.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
